timeChunked.title: Time-chunked dataset in Zarr
timeChunked.description:
An ARCO version of this dataset with a small chunk size in the temporal dimension.
    
Note that the link (`href`) associated to this asset is the base directory
of this dataset, but it cannot be accessed directly.

To download this dataset or part of it, 
use a library such as [xarray](https://docs.xarray.dev/).
